name: AMBER
description: AMBER is an LLM-free multi-dimensional benchmark designed to evaluate hallucinations in Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs). It covers both generative and discriminative tasks, including existence, attribute, and relation hallucination, providing a low-cost and efficient evaluation pipeline.
reputation: A widely used benchmark for probing hallucination behavior in multimodal large language models.
notes: Focuses on hallucination evaluation in MLLMs without relying on LLMs or humans; covers multiple hallucination types.
